title: AgentAction
description: Audit record for one tool call made by the agent loop. Makes the demo legible and lets a failed Ambiguous call be retried without re-prompting the user. Exactly one of result or error is set. Defined by the data model in docs/API.md.

tool.description: tool name from docs/API.md, e.g. book_job

result.description: tool return value; absent when the call failed
